name: Sun Cleric: Valkyr's Grip lets a Valkyrie dual-wield two-handed polearms (#5016, #5371, #5537, #4591)
contract: Valkyr's Grip 707072 (SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE, cast on learn per Player::_addSpell's cast-passive-at-learn path) description reads 'Allows you to dual wield and to wield a Two-Handed Mace, Sword, or Polearm in each hand...' (Description[enUS], confirmed via coa-dbc-viewer against /home/fab/CoaServer/dbc_clientset). Its cast runs Spell::EffectTitanGrip, which sets Player::m_canTitanGrip, and its Effect[2] SPELL_EFFECT_DUAL_WIELD grants dual wield. Player::CanTitanGrip (Player.cpp) refused any off-hand polearm unless HasBurningCommander() (a hardcoded Demon Hunter-only bypass), so a Sun Cleric with Valkyr's Grip active could equip two swords but never two polearms, even though the same tooltip and DBC (AscensionCustomClassData.h TalentProficiencies {27,707072,200}) grant polearm proficiency for this talent. Fix adds Player::HasValkyrGrip() (Sun Cleric class + HasActiveSpell(707072)) to the same bypass used by HasBurningCommander. Equipping two different 2H polearms (Test Polearm 4901 main hand, Fast Test Polearm 5545 off hand; both RequiredSkill 0, AllowableClass -1, so no unrelated proficiency/class gate can mask the result) must both succeed and the off hand must carry real weapon damage, not the unarmed default.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Test Polearm in the main hand
Fast Test Polearm in the off hand
Main-hand polearm carries real weapon damage
Off-hand polearm carries real weapon damage
